parsed.summary: The Lean theorem proves only that, for α ≥ 0 and a continuous bounded log-potential f, the bespoke EReal-valued variational value inf_q [α·P_f(q) + I(q)] is a finite real number. It is a finiteness/well-posedness lemma. The paper's main result (Theorem 2.3: the Ising perceptron pressure converges to this variational formula for bounded Borel f) is not formalized. The most important caveat is that the pattern functional is a bespoke limit along uniform discretizations, totalized via limUnder. Finiteness also follows almost directly from bounds such as I(q) ≥ 0 (take the zero field) and |P_f| ≤ K, so the statement says little about whether these definitions match the paper's.

glossary.plain: T_{s,d}U(x) = E[U(x+√s Z)] if d=0, otherwise (1/d) log E[exp(d·U(x+√s Z))], with Z ~ N(0,1).
glossary.standard_concept: one step of the Parisi/Ruelle-cascade recursion
glossary.note: Integrals are well defined for bounded measurable U; non-integrable cases would give junk values.

glossary.standard_concept: breakpoints of a step Parisi parameter

glossary.plain: A partition together with nondecreasing nonnegative field levels h_0 ≤ … ≤ h_{k-1}
glossary.standard_concept: step field / dual variable for the Ising entropy
glossary.note: Exact definition in the paper is not in the excerpt.

glossary.plain: Nested recursion of T with variance increments h_i − h_{i−1} and exponents m_i, terminal function log cosh x − h_{k−1}/2, evaluated at x = 0
glossary.note: Not in excerpt. Level indexing and the terminal term are plausible.

glossary.plain: An a.e.-class on (0,1) with a nondecreasing representative taking values in [0,1]
Parisi-type recursion applied to f, using the cell averages of q on a uniform grid with k=n+1 cells, a final level 1, and exponents i/k
glossary.standard_concept: pattern functional for a step path

glossary.plain: Limit as n→∞ of uniformPattern; if no limit exists, Lean returns a fixed junk value
glossary.note: Relies on convergence. limUnder is totalized when the sequence does not converge.

glossary.plain: I(q) = sup over field steps h of [fieldRecursion(h) + ½∫ h(u) q(u) du], valued in EReal
glossary.standard_concept: dual of the log cosh recursion (Ising entropy term)
glossary.note: Sign and normalization are not verifiable from the excerpt. I(q) ≥ 0 via h = 0, and it can be +∞ (e.g. q ≡ 1).

glossary.plain: inf over q of α·P_f(q) + I(q), valued in EReal

lean_claims.plain: For every α ≥ 0 and every continuous f: ℝ→ℝ with sup|f| ≤ K for some K, there is p ∈ ℝ with variationalValue α f = p, i.e. the value is neither +∞ nor −∞.

paper_claims.plain: For every α > 0 and every bounded Borel f, the Ising perceptron pressure converges in expectation and in probability to the explicit variational formula.
Not in excerpt; presumably implicit in Theorem 2.3, since the formula equals a finite limit.

coverage.why: Lean proves only finiteness of the formula, not convergence of the pressure; it also restricts f to continuous functions.

flags.explanation: The main result (the limiting free energy equals the variational formula) is not formalized. Only finiteness of the formula is proved.

The pattern functional is defined as limUnder along uniform-grid discretizations. If the sequence fails to converge, it is a junk constant. The paper's definition is not in the excerpt. Finiteness holds regardless, so the theorem does not certify that the definition is meaningful.
flags.probe_idea: Prove ∀ q, Tendsto (uniformPattern f q) atTop (𝓝 (patternFunctional f q)) for continuous bounded f.

flags.explanation: The sign, normalization and indexing of the entropy dual cannot be checked against the excerpt. Finiteness follows from I ≥ 0 (zero field) plus I(0) ≤ 0, which would also hold for many mis-specified variants.
flags.probe_idea: Evaluate isingEntropy at the constant path q ≡ c and compare with the replica-symmetric Ising entropy formula from the paper.

flags.explanation: Lean requires f continuous, whereas the paper allows bounded Borel f. Lean also allows α = 0, whereas the paper requires α > 0; this part is harmless and slightly stronger.
flags.probe_idea: Restate the theorem with hf : Measurable f in place of continuity.
